Mark Delaney founded the Company in {{company.founded}} and owns it. It employs {{hc.total}} people besides the owner, {{hc.field}} in the field, and has {{kpi.maintenance_members}} maintenance-agreement members {{fn.mgmt}}. Before discounts, FY2025 revenue of {{rev.latest}} was {{line.residential.share0.FY2025}} residential, {{line.commercial.share0.FY2025}} commercial and {{line.maintenance.share0.FY2025}} maintenance agreements; the {{cust.billedCount}} listed commercial customers billed in FY2025 were {{cust.codedShare}} of it, the largest {{cust.largestShare}}. s10_1.title: The owner targets a closing within 12 months and will stay up to {{owner.transitionMonths}} months after it
s10_1.transaction: Mark Delaney, the founder and owner, is offering the operating assets of Ridgeline Comfort Services LLC; he prefers an asset sale {{fn.mgmt}}. He is retiring at {{owner.age}} and wants a clean exit within 12 months. He is open to a buyer keeping the Ridgeline name and all {{hc.total}} employees. Offers should assume an asset purchase in which the Seller keeps cash, receivables and payables.
s10_1.transition: The owner will stay up to {{owner.transitionMonths}} months after closing and introduce the commercial customers {{fn.mgmt}}. Lisa Tran, operations manager and with the Company {{mgmt.lisa.tenure}}, runs dispatch and day-to-day scheduling and is expected to stay. The {{hc.field}} field employees are paid hourly plus spiff commissions on maintenance agreements, with no union.
s10_1.premises: The Company leases an {{kpi.shop_size}} shop and office on Maple Ave from an unrelated landlord; the lease runs through 2029 with a five-year renewal option {{fn.mgmt}}. The fleet is {{kpi.fleet_service_vans}} service vans and {{kpi.fleet_install_trucks}} install trucks, owned and financed with vehicle loans. ServiceTitan runs dispatch, invoicing and memberships, and QuickBooks Online the books.
s10_1.process: We will invite qualified buyers who have signed a confidentiality agreement to an introductory call and then a management meeting, on the timetable set out on {{page:S10.2}}. All inquiries should be directed to AMB Advisory. Do not contact the Seller or its employees directly.
